name: i3deploy-release
description: Cut i3deploy releases from Claude Code — ServiceRelease + ProjectRelease (user-facing & technical changelogs). Drafts notes from git + the current session + memory + whichever task manager you use (ProWoDo, Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues — or none), dedups against existing versions, and publishes via the bundled i3deploy MCP server (OAuth, no API key). Can target a release at a named audience (beta testers, staff) with its own changelog text and its own feed. Auto-triggers on release/changelog mentions.
